page: OVHcloud r3-128 is a memory-optimized server instance powered by an AMD EPYC processor with 16 dedicated physical cores and 16 vCPUs running at 2.3 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The server is equipped with 128.0 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It includes 400 GB of local NVMe SSD storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 4 Gbps, running on a KVM hypervisor.

In benchmark evaluations, the r3-128 demonstrates strong memory subsystem performance, achieving a top-tier rating in the Passmark memory score. Large-block uncached memory read and write bandwidth tests both rank in the top 25%, indicating efficient data throughput for large datasets. Single-core CPU performance via stress-ng is also strong, while multi-core CPU performance and Geekbench scores generally align with the middle 50% average. Multi-threaded bzip3 decompression and text processing benchmarks also show strong performance.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the r3-128 offers a high-density memory configuration paired with dedicated AMD EPYC cores, making it a viable option for memory-bound workloads without the premium of GPU hardware. The combination of 128 GB of RAM, dedicated CPU allocation, and local NVMe storage makes this instance suitable for database hosting, in-memory caching, text processing, and medium-scale data processing tasks.
